findings.detail: The source nets Senior Secured Loans by an Unfunded Loan Commitments fair-value offset of -257.115 million, but the extracted fair-value sum overshoots the reported investment anchor.
The source nets Asset Based Finance by an Unfunded Commitments fair-value offset of -57.422 million, contributing to the conservation overshoot.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check: the filing total investments row and companyfacts anchor are 1,536.368 million, while the extracted fair-value sum is 1,873.983 million. The SOI disposition shows gross category totals are reduced by explicit negative unfunded commitment rows, including -257.115 million and -57.422 million. Those source rows support an extraction gap in the position set, so the conservation overshoot is a real data error rather than a bad anchor. The cited negative rows explain most, but not necessarily all, of the residual; the independent anchor disagreement grounds the verdict.
